lines: The Apex compensation plan is built on two ladders — and you can climb one, or both.
The first is the Technology ladder. It's open to everyone — licensed, or not.
You earn by putting Apex's A.I. tools in the hands of businesses — and by building a team that does the same.
On every sale, you keep the majority — and a share flows up through your team as override income.
Nine ranks, from Starter to Elite. Each one unlocks deeper override levels — and one-time rank bonuses.
The second ladder is Insurance — for licensed agents.
You earn fifty to ninety percent of first-year premium, paid directly by A-rated carriers — on a book of business you own.
Build a team of agents, and you earn generational overrides on their production — up to six generations deep.
Here's what makes Apex different. The two ladders are completely separate — but you can run both at once.
Lead with technology. Build an insurance career. Or stack them together.
Two ladders. One opportunity. This is the Apex compensation plan.
